title: Feature request: inform about empty translation in tabs (`TabbedTranslationAdmin`)
author: adi-
body_preview: I think it would be very helpful if `TabbedTranslationAdmin` visually indicated when a translation is missing in one of the language tabs. For example, the tab could display an icon, a star or other similar text sign, a colored border, or different styling to let users immediately see which translations still need to be completed.

title: Parse the WFS URL from the DescribeLayer response for remote WMS resources
author: giohappy

title: Metadata: track changes
author: etj
body_preview: An optional step during metadata save operations will compare the changed fields before/after the requested change. Changes will be tracked inside an activity stream action.

title: Management command for metadata validation
